esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\vssadmin.exe") and process.command_line like "*delete*" and process.command_line like "*shadows*" or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\wmic.exe") and process.command_line like "*shadowcopy*" and process.command_line like "*delete*"

kql.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "delete" and ProcessCommandLine contains "shadows")) or (FolderPath endswith "\\wmic.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine contains "delete"))

title: Shadow copies deleted
triage_tips: Check the host for mass file renames after this alert.
Either the vssadmin or the wmic form triggers it.
Known false positive: backup software cleanup.
what_it_is: Sigma rule chm-win-006 (critical, test status): vssadmin or wmic deleting shadow copies, a ransomware precursor.
why_it_flags: Process creation where vssadmin.exe has delete and shadows, or wmic.exe has shadowcopy and delete, in the command line.
